box.title: 1a. What is BloomingLeaf
box.text: `BloomingLeaf is a tool that allows users to build goal models and use them to visualize their goals and tradeoffs in a certain situation. Goal models represent the interconnected needs of different stakeholders in a scenario and how the satisfaction of some elements affects other elements. Goal models allow analysts to visualize how making certain decisions may affect other parts of a project.`
box.rdest: 1b. Discover the purpose of your analysis

box.title: 1b. Discover the purpose of your analysis
box.text:
`BloomingLeaf allows users to ask and answer questions about a given situation. In order to answer these questions, one must first build a model, and then analyze the satisfaction values of different elemeents of the model. Here are some examples of questions that may be analyzed through this tool:
  • Does it matter if Goal A or Goal B is satisfied first?
  • Is Goal A or Goal B satisfied more often?
  • Given that Task A is not currently satisfied, is it possible for Goal B to become satisfied?
  • Can Goal A remain satisfied if Goal B becomes not satisfed?
`
